modes.summary: Only the winner takes the win reward; everyone else takes the loss reward plus 10 Merit per opponent beyond the first.
Standard rewards; in 2v2 both members of the winning team earn the win.
Beating the Boss is a win; Merit scales with the stage reached. Co-op partners earn together.
